mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, so the mechanism predicts positive returns when FEDFUNDS is low. The signal is always active as FEDFUNDS is continuously available.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the presence of the signal are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in the presence of the signal are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
